explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/727 (Erdős–Graham–Ruzsa–Straus): 'Let k ≥ 2. Does (n+k)!² | (2n)! for infinitely many n?'. The Lean statement is ∀ k ≥ 2, {n : ℕ | ((n+k)!)² ∣ (2n)!} is infinite, tagged as a yes/no question, which is the natural reading (every k ≥ 2; the page notes it is open even for k = 2). Faithful.
